39031.rationale: Reviewed every supplied field for all ten records and compared each identity with both other seeds. Semantic variable sets, units, empirical-versus-commercial distinctions, complete-product roles and literal PACE-041 through PACE-048 / FLOW-049 / FLOW-050 identities are preserved. b041/b047 retain dry/no-water testing with month and unloaded mass; b042/b048 retain the explicit commercial-only distinction with carton dimensions and advertised price; b043/b044 retain three wet-traction variables; b045 retains only friction and roughness (no measured water depth); b046 retains only friction; b049/b050 retain flow, operating dB(A) and microphone distance. Both or all three distribution synopses in each record have consistent variable/value content; every CSV describes a comma-separated table and every PDF describes tables inside PDF. Additional third distributions repeat a representation, not a new experiment or variable. Meaningful metadata variation exists across seeds in prose ordering, paragraphing, description length, title wording, column order, optional spatial fields, publisher/location context and third-distribution presence/format. For example b045 has extensive reuse prose here whereas b043 separates study, basis and distribution statements into paragraphs. This is preservation of semantic measurement coverage, NOT identical literal numerical facts: e.g. b041 mass examples are 500.53, 606.08 and 1517.17 g across the seeds, and study locations/publishers also change. Values are explicitly introduced as examples and have been recorded per seed rather than asserted equal. Generic field guides and missing-cell notes add no measurements. All titles, keywords, publisher and supplied spatial fields were reviewed; no temporal field is supplied. No instruction/answer-key/grade leakage or within-seed duplicate whole record was observed. Verification is of complete packet metadata and distribution format/content association, not downloaded file bytes; omitted duplicate production queryContext text was not independently inspected. No corpus-wide coverage or query-paraphrase claim is made because actual query strings and records outside this packet are not provided.

39032.rationale: All ten records were individually read through their complete supplied descriptions, titles, keywords, publisher fields, distribution fields and any spatial fields, then compared with seeds 39031 and 39033. Identity strings and semantic fact sets are unchanged: b041/b047 dry/no-water road-shoe observations have month and mass; b042/b048 are commercial ledgers with carton dimensions and advertised cost despite their wet-testing subject; b043/b044 measure friction, roughness and water depth; b045 measures friction and roughness only; b046 measures friction only; b049/b050 are empirical indoor hydraulic-pump acoustic/flow tests with microphone distance. There is no inference of missing variables from activity names or negations. Each distribution matches its record's column/value list and its CSV/comma-separated or PDF/table description. Here b041 has a third CSV, b043/b044/b046 have a third PDF, while b042/b045/b047/b048/b049/b050 have two representations; these changes do not alter variable coverage. Meaningful wording/length variation is visible: b047 is compact, b046 and both pump records have much longer interpretive prose, and subjects/basis/column descriptions move between sentence and paragraph positions. Titles, fictional sites/publishers, examples, column order and optional spatial presence also vary, not just a category prefix. Semantic coverage is preserved, not exact numeric equality: b045 friction examples are 0.78, 0.35 and 0.45 across the seeds, with roughness 0.2, 1.17 and 1.04 mm. These are expressly illustrative e.g. values, not a claim of value-identical observations across releases. No contradiction, searchable instruction, answer key or whole-record duplicate was observed within this packet. No temporal fields were supplied. Distribution verification is metadata association only; no files were downloaded. Duplicate queryContext copies were omitted by the packet and were not independently reviewed; actual query wording, exact-query equivalences and global corpus coverage cannot be audited from this packet.

39033.rationale: Exhaustively reviewed all ten supplied records and compared each with both other seeded versions. Complete-shoe versus pump product roles, authoritative PACE/FLOW strings, observed rather than simulated basis, and each documented variable set remain stable. The commercial records b042/b048 must remain commercial-ledger contexts, not be recast as experimental wet traction merely because of their study wording. b041/b047 still explicitly exclude water application; b043/b044 retain measured roughness, wet friction and water depth; b045 has roughness and friction without a measured water-depth column; b046 has friction alone; b049/b050 retain flow rate, operating sound pressure and microphone distance. Distribution variable/value lists are internally aligned for every record: two representations here except three for b042/b043/b046/b049/b050, with the third a PDF except b050's CSV. Each format is consistent with its own table synopsis. There is meaningful prose variation in statement ordering, one-paragraph versus multi-paragraph descriptions, title constructions and extensive versus compact reuse notes, as well as column ordering and optional spatial metadata. Sites, institutional publishers and illustrative numeric examples also change across seeds; exact numerical facts are not preserved and were not treated as equal. For example FLOW-050 sound examples are 53.22, 50.66 and 35.77 dB(A), distances 2.66, 2.53 and 1.55 m, and flows 23.13, 36.53 and 13.88 litres/minute. The stable semantic coverage judgment concerns types, units, roles and qualifiers, not a single unchanged experimental sample. All supplied title/keyword/publisher/spatial content was reviewed, with no temporal fields supplied and no observed answer-key/instruction leakage or within-seed duplicate whole records. Only packet metadata association was verified, not actual file bytes or omitted duplicate queryContext copies. Actual query strings and the rest of the corpus are unavailable under this audit scope, so no global coverage, exact-query equivalence or ranking assertion follows.
